Handoff is written to `HANDOFF.md` in the project root.

It leads with the rollback, then root cause, then the impact window. All log lines in it are quoted exact.

Two things I worked out while writing it. The failure window is 530 of 636 requests, 83%. On-call was paged 67 minutes after the first 503.

I also flagged that this log is `node-3 of 3`. The other two nodes almost certainly have the same problem.
